findings.reason: The statement defines Theta to conjugate coefficients, but writes reflection positivity as <(Theta F)^* F>. With the ordinary algebra adjoint, this conjugates coefficients again and can reverse the sign of the standard positive form (take F=i phi(f) with real f). Use <Theta(F) F> for an antilinear reflection, or define a linear reflection and the matching adjoint convention. Define its action on tensor components as well.

The stress-energy tensor is introduced as a spacetime distribution, but the charge formula uses T^{0 nu}(0,x) without defining its restriction to the time-zero slice. The phrase “when these cutoff limits act on D” also leaves existence of those limits unclear. Specify a sharp-time restriction or time-smearing limit and require the spatial cutoff charges to exist on D and equal the translation generators.

The OPE remainder is specified, but the perturbative requirements still refer to the “pure Yang–Mills perturbative beta function” and “prescribed perturbative Yang–Mills singularities and scale dependence” without giving the coefficient data, renormalization convention, or precise asymptotic remainder condition. Make those requirements exact or obtain owner reconciliation of this added scope.
